title: Ashfall Chronicles — A 2D Sandbox RPG Built Around Interconnected Systems
author: Responsible_Main2053
selftext:
For the past two months, I've been working on a 2D pixel browser RPG called Ashfall Chronicles, created entirely using AI — from the code and fonts to the visual assets and music.

I put together a short gameplay video this time to show a little more of what the game currently feels like to play.

The game is still in development, but most of the core systems are now playable. The foundation is in place, including multiplayer and the development environment. I'm currently focusing on polishing the game feel and refining the moment-to-moment gameplay to build a genuinely fun and complete experience.

Making this short video also made me notice a few small issues with the game feel that are harder to notice during normal development. Movement, combat feedback, interactions, balancing, and some of the transitions still need more work.

So while the game is already playable, I don't think this version represents what Ashfall Chronicles will eventually become.

There are still a lot of systems, interactions, and world changes that I want to bring together, and I'm hoping the game will feel much more cohesive as those pieces start connecting.

**This is still an early look at Ashfall Chronicles. There's much more coming.**
